svg.text: Utilisation per option: minibuses, borrowed hours and borrowed days
Minibus utilisation = owned busy minutes (route + cooldown) / (owned minibuses x common daily service span). Borrowed hours = f3. Borrowed days = f4.
Right-hand numbers: borrowed utilisation (busy / time on loan, first start to last end) and share of borrowed time before 10:00.
